_comment: Calibrated tail conventions per (vector, enzyme, application). Adding a new triple = one entry here + (if needed) a new TailRuleFn in lib/primer_design/vectors.py. Keys are formatted as 'vector|enzyme|application'.

pEXG2|HindIII|deletion.name: site_destroyed
pEXG2|HindIII|deletion.calibrated_against: P1 spans nick to include the 4-nt sticky end (AGCT) so the PCR product aligns with the bottom strand after exonuclease chewing. Tail length = 20 nt (Takara In-Fusion standard).

pEXG2|HindIII|tagging.name: site_destroyed
pEXG2|HindIII|tagging.calibrated_against: shares pEXG2|HindIII|deletion convention; cassette junction overlap differs (see D6.4)

pBBR1MCS2|HindIII|expression.name: site_partial_AAGCT
pBBR1MCS2|HindIII|expression._geometry_note: Addgene pBBR1MCS-2 (#85168) MCS reads 5'->3' as ...SalI-ClaI-HindIII-EcoRV-EcoRI... P1 tail = 15 nt left-arm context + first 5 nt of AAGCTT = 20 nt total. P4 tail = RC of 20 nt at nick.
pBBR1MCS2|HindIII|expression.calibrated_against: PA14 lasR primer #1612 / lasB primer #1573 (working empirical set); tail length updated to 20 nt 2026-06
